## Linked Issue

Refs #1895

<!-- Choose exactly one primary line: Refs #1234 keeps unfinished issue work open; Closes #1234 is for the child issue fully accepted by this PR. Keep ordinary explanations and related issues as Markdown links; use Closes only when the complete issue is accepted. -->

## Scope Summary

- R24 is a bounded SOURCE-only increment of #1895. Exact base `d5773ef97f55176a1eab67e677790f3e13352a7b`; actual local UI961 `c77281165226ffd84223c4c8d43805c5deb2b1b3`. Only two production paths plus the ordinary task WIP.
- `useCodeBlockCopy.ts` now mounts the existing public `FsusUiButton` via Vue `h`/`render` and the owning component's `appContext`. Reactive state drives the public slot/ARIA label. Each pre retains its original source capture and marker; a noninteractive span holds the Vue mount without a component wrapper or createApp.
- Original cleanup stops each render effect, calls `render(null, container)`, removes its container and clears timers. Generation/disposal guards prevent an awaited enhancement from mounting after cleanup/unmount; a clipboard completion after cleanup preserves its original toast while creating no orphan timer. Original locale refresh and reveal/kill owners remain.
- Only code-copy CSS rules change: keep original host and top/right positioning; remove the copied generic Button geometry/color/hover/focus/opacity kernel and code-copy-only motion overrides. Other markdown CSS and the clipboard fallback are byte-identical.
- Original `writeClipboard` bytes, browser fallback, rights.allowCodeCopy check, code/pre text capture, stop/prevent behavior, localized keys and success/error toast durations remain. No ArticleDetail edit, alternate clipboard service, registry, schema, fixtures, receipts, tests or authorities.

<!-- The gate requires a substantive summary and at least one checked Tests Run entry. -->

## Change Classification

- [x] Behavior change
- [ ] Format-only
- [ ] Naming-only
- [ ] Generated output
- [ ] Public contract change
- [ ] External naming exception
- Contract impact: none

`Behavior change`, `Format-only`, and `Naming-only` are mutually exclusive. `Generated output`, `Public contract change`, and `External naming exception` are supplementary.

The gate reads fields only from their named section, rejects duplicate fields or headings hidden in fenced examples, and requires contract checkboxes to be checked. Record a not-applicable reason in `Notes For Reviewers` before checking that review item.

## Tests Run

- [ ] `./tools/test.sh fast`
- [ ] Targeted backend tests: HOLD/UNRUN; no backend source change
- [x] Targeted frontend checks: original complete application typecheck under real UI961 alias on base and source candidate, exit2 on both with byte-identical29 diagnostics; original strict/noUnused/erasable configuration preserved. Changed-file original lint: TypeScript0, pre-existing CSS word-break warning at line11 remains outside owned rules.
- [x] Other: Original full repository frontend lint FAIL1 on both:83667 to83666 raw lines, no added diagnostic and only the original helper no-misused-promises removed; complete line/multiplicity comparison, no normalization. Existing baseline drift and unrelated diagnostics retained. Code-intent2 existing errors retained; git diff whitespace/title/range/repository gates and actual base/head inspected. Exact clipboard function hash and non-copy CSS hash unchanged. No product or parser module evaluation, runtime, tests, discovery, browser, native or database work.

## UI Evidence

- [ ] Screenshots or video attached for UI changes
- [ ] Mobile layout checked
- [ ] Dark mode checked
- [ ] Accessibility and reduced-motion impact considered

## Coding Convention

- [x] C# mother-style mapping checked
- [x] Formatter/linter run
- [x] No tool default overrides repository style
- [x] Mechanical formatting separated from logic
- [x] `.git-blame-ignore-revs` updated when applicable

For a `Format-only` change, complete every field. The idempotence evidence must be one repository-relative `.json` path changed by this PR and conform to `fsusblog.format-idempotence-evidence.v1`. Use `none` for other changes.

- Formatter identity: none
- Formatter version: none
- Formatter command: none
- Formatter idempotence evidence: none
- Blame-ignore revision: none

## External Naming Exception

For a checked `External naming exception`, point to one changed repository-relative JSON manifest using `fsusblog.external-naming-exceptions.v1`. Each entry binds one registered exception ID to its own changed paths and substantive reason; the union must exactly cover every changed registered naming surface. A missing manifest already named by an authoritative merged PR may instead use `fsusblog.post-merge-external-naming-evidence-repair.v1`; that strict repair binds immutable merge history, unchanged source blob/revision identity, the registered surface, and the exact missing artifact without changing the source again. Use `none` otherwise.

- Exceptions manifest: none

## Documentation / Intent

- [x] Public API docs updated
- [x] Ownership/security/performance intent updated
- [x] Historical handoff archived or source-of-truth updated
- [x] TODO/FIXME references valid issues

## Compatibility And Risk

- [x] [Cross-language coding conventions](../docs/development/coding-conventions.md) reviewed
- [x] Document lifecycle updated: stable facts are current; issue handoffs are historical/proposed; generated docs identify their producer
- [x] External wire / ABI / database / third-party names preserved or explicitly adapted
- [x] Public API impact reviewed
- [x] AEDS frame / binary contract impact reviewed
- [x] Database migration impact reviewed
- [x] Security, auth, moderation, PoW, or privacy impact reviewed
- [x] Docs updated or a reason is recorded below
- [x] Known limitations updated if applicable

## Performance Claim

Use `none` and `Evidence path: none` unless the PR title type is `perf`. For S/M/R/C, the evidence path must be a changed repository-relative JSON manifest using `fsusblog.performance-claim-evidence.v1`; it binds the one perf commit SHA, claim level, `structural-only`/`measured` status, and each changed evidence file with its SHA-256 digest.

- Claim level: none
- Evidence path: none
- Non-goals: no performance, lifecycle, rendered UX, qualification or complete issue acceptance claim

## Release Note

The matching `release-note:*` label selects the generated release category. GitHub renders the merged PR title as the release entry, so every included category requires `Summary` to exactly equal the summary portion of the PR title after `type(scope):`; `Category: none` instead requires `Summary: none`. Pure formatting, internal renames, and CI rearrangement must use `Internal/Tooling` or `none`.

- Audience: internal
- Category: Internal/Tooling
- Summary: delegate code copy controls to FsusUI Button

## Generated Output

For a checked `Generated output`, bind the output to its source through one repository-relative `.json` manifest path changed by this PR. Normal atomic source/output changes use `fsusblog.generated-output-binding.v1`. A generated-only repair for a source omission already merged into the PR base uses `fsusblog.post-merge-generated-output-repair.v1`; it must name one trusted producer and leave its source and generator unchanged. A trusted ordered multi-producer repair uses `fsusblog.post-merge-generated-output-repair-dag.v2` and its registry-owned canonical manifest path. An authenticated bot must identify itself exactly. Use `none` otherwise.

- Generator source: none
- Generated outputs: none
- Digest/evidence: none
- Automation identity: none

## Rollout / Rollback

- Rollout: independent draft source review only; no activation or publication
- Rollback: revert only this two-file source commit; no data or schema changes
- Deferred work: independent SOURCE review and all original runtime, lifecycle, keyboard, appContext, browser, theme, viewport, locale and qualification acceptance remain HOLD/UNRUN
- Known limitations: full static typecheck and lint failures remain visible; changed CSS line11 is outside this fsus-code-copy-only scope; no rendered or lifecycle acceptance

## Notes For Reviewers

CODEOWNERS may request the configured maintainer for touched paths, but it does not replace this contract. Name the child issue actually closed and keep API, UI, database, security, generated, and mechanical changes separated unless the linked issue explicitly requires one atomic boundary.

The executable change-contract policy files are evaluated from the trusted base and cannot be replaced by the candidate PR that they judge. Until branch protection is available, their bootstrap update is an owner-controlled direct push followed by the post-push audit; do not describe that audit as preventive protection.

Ordinary WIP: `artifacts/work-in-progress/r24-code-copy-button.json`. This is prescribed consumer control delegation on the reading surface; FsusUI owns generic Button and keyboard/focus semantics, Blog owns clipboard/content-right workflow and position. Both Skills and source authorities are hash-bound as ordinary read-only context in WIP. No formal classification/acceptance receipt or authority record was created under the caller's SOURCE-only scope.

No public wire/API/schema/ABI/database or design authority change requires documentation changes. Existing public Button contracts apply; ordinary WIP records the consumer increment and remaining work. C# mapping, mechanical formatting/blame-ignore, generated outputs, naming exceptions, TODO changes and UI evidence checkboxes were reviewed as inapplicable or remain unchecked. No user-visible rendered claim is made.

The owning appContext is captured during setup through exported Vue APIs and assigned to the public VNode field. Missing owning context fails before any mount; no private app._context, instance.$, Button DOM mutation, createApp, generic wrapper or replacement provider. New mount lifetime is SOURCE only and needs independent runtime coverage; static compilation cannot accept cleanup or keyboard behavior.

Two current installed profiles are recorded rather than substituted: Blog TS6.0.3/vue-tsc3.2.7/Vue3.5.33 and UI dependency cache TS6.0.2/vue-tsc3.2.6/Vue3.5.32; public aliases consume exact clean UI961 source. No mock/stub/reduced configuration or published-package guess. Original static CLI/toolchain only; npm ci used the original style lock with lifecycle scripts disabled because configured style CLIs were initially missing.

All runtime, tests/discovery/listing/collection, product/helper/parser module execution, browser/native/database/frozen/qualification remain HOLD/UNRUN. No merge/Ready/issue closure/package publication/authority refresh. No test, registry, schema, fixture, receipt, gate or configuration edited. Missing remote checks are not passes.

Delivery identity: exact base `d5773ef97f55176a1eab67e677790f3e13352a7b`; final head `f89ffd18c5e24679ff48daec4b14e5ba815b7cef`; checked source head `6af0ffab31048879672b4fe79768c135064f47ee`. Three changed paths: exactly two owned production files and ordinary WIP.
